summary: The agent could not apply PRP-001 because the save was rejected: a class cannot sit on the Browser client node, which holds only plain `public/index.html`, so the design is unchanged. The developer should choose between keeping the browser free of classes by modelling the task-list behaviour as use-case and requirement text on DSN-003 (the agent's recommendation, which leaves REQ-002 criterion 3 without a class method), moving `TaskListView` to the server-side `Tasks` node, or changing the environment's constraint so browser-side classes are allowed. The agent will apply whichever option is picked.
